id.description: A unique identifier for the auto attendant.

name.description: Unique name for the auto attendant.

locationName.description: Name of location for auto attendant.

locationId.description: ID of location for auto attendant.

phoneNumber.description: Auto attendant phone number.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

extension.description: Auto attendant extension.  Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

esn.description: Routing prefix + extension of a person or workspace.

tollFreeNumber.description: Flag to indicate if auto attendant number is toll-free number.
